scope: New registry/proposals/ entry (registry/proposals/flood_readout_trend.json, PROP-FLOOD-01 and PROP-FLOOD-02): two method-domain (M) proposals for a private Sammakorn village (Ramkhamhaeng 112, Bangkok) flood-readout application, via the governed proposals-lane intake process -- NOT promoted into registry/CANONICAL.json, which requires the full schema/lineage/checker workflow these entries have not gone through. PROP-FLOOD-01 is a lag-k retained difference with an epsilon-resolution sign readout (RISING/FALLING/FLAT/NO_READOUT), citing delta_R (instance_of) and PROP-FLOOD-01's own sibling PROP-NATIVE-01 (generalises) as parents, both quoted/cited, not restated as new theorems. PROP-FLOOD-02 is a time-to-threshold linear extension of PROP-FLOOD-01's rate, total via an explicit REFUSED (UNRESOLVED/NOT_APPLICABLE) branch, citing PROP-FLOOD-01 (linear_extension) and delta_R (instance_of) as parents. Both entries are tier Dr / status unverified, carry explicit claim_boundary/honest_caveats disclaiming any hydrological model content and any forecast claim, and empirical_test_status is 'not yet run' / 'none'. No claim about the Clay Millennium Navier-Stokes problem, or about any object's Clay/NS status, is made or implied anywhere in this change; the status of every existing Clay-related registry object (CANONICAL.json, coq/, docs/CLAY_*) is unchanged -- this PR touches no such object, only adds one new proposals-lane file.

todo.evidence: Design-stage application proposals for a private flood-readout tool; not yet empirically tested, so no research TODO item is opened or closed by this PR.
